# GitHub configuration

[workflows/](workflows/README.md) contains the GitHub Actions definitions. Check the actual runs for a commit: a workflow's presence does not mean its jobs passed.

[Issue forms](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/) cover bugs, performance regressions and feature
requests. The [pull request template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) keeps changes,
validation and remaining limits visible to reviewers.

See [Contributing](../CONTRIBUTING.md), the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
and the [security policy](../SECURITY.md) for project guidelines and private
reporting channels.
